text: 下面进入小作文 07 · 道歉与说明信：因突发科研任务无法按期赴会答题骨架与变体精解。
第一段：直接陈述失约事实并表达深切歉意。
I am writing this letter with sincere regret to apologize for being unable to attend tomorrow's symposium as previously scheduled.
道歉母句：I am writing with sincere regret to apologize for being unable to do sth.。
I am writing with sincere regret to apologize for being unable to attend the symposium.
第二段：解释合情合理、无可推卸的紧急客观事由（突发科研任务）。
Much to my distress, our laboratory has been assigned an emergency national research task, which prevents me from being absent.
情态副词状语短语：Much to my distress / Much to my regret, ...
Much to my distress, our laboratory has been assigned an emergency research task.
第三段：主动提供补救替代时间并重申歉意。
Would it be possible for us to reschedule our meeting for next Tuesday? Please accept my deepest apologies once again.
委婉改期商量句型：Would it be possible for us to reschedule our appointment for [Date]?
Would it be possible for us to reschedule our meeting for next Tuesday?
